runs.text: One pipeline under the Sinai coast. In twenty twenty, the gas started flowing the other way. two thousand and eight. Egypt sells gas to Israel, through this pipe from El Arish to Ashkelon. In twenty eleven and twenty twelve, attackers in Sinai blow up the line again and again. In twenty twelve, Egypt cancels the deal. But Israel has already struck gas at sea. Tamar, in two thousand and nine. Leviathan, in twenty ten. Tamar starts pumping in twenty thirteen. Leviathan, at the end of twenty nineteen. January twenty twenty. The old pipe runs in reverse. Israeli gas flows into Egypt. Jordan gets Israeli gas too. In twenty twenty four, Israel produces a <<ˈ|r|ɛ|k|ɚ|d>> twenty seven point four billion cubic meters. Almost half goes abroad. Thirteen point one billion, to Egypt and Jordan. Egypt buys about ten billion a year. Jordan, about three. Can energy make peace last longer? Tell me in the comments. Same pipe. Same desert. Just flowing the other way.
